name: Onboarding Agent - New Employee Onboarding
prompt_template: Job Offer accepted: {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.applicant_name }} (Job Applicant {{ doc.job_applicant }}). Begin onboarding.
title: Onboarding Agent - New Employee Onboarding

name: Offboarding Agent - Employee Separation Created
prompt_template: Employee Separation {{ doc.name }} created for {{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.employee }}), boarding begins {{ doc.boarding_begins_on }}. Begin offboarding.
title: Offboarding Agent - Employee Separation Created

name: Attendance Agent - Leave Application Filed
prompt_template: New Leave Application: {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.employee_name }} — {{ doc.leave_type }}, {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }} ({{ doc.total_leave_days }} day(s)). Decide.
title: Attendance Agent - Leave Application Filed

name: Resume Shortlisting Agent - New Job Applicant
prompt_template: New Job Applicant {{ doc.name }} ({{ doc.applicant_name }}) applied for Job Opening {{ doc.job_title }}. Screen the attached resume against this job's requirements and record a match score.
title: Resume Shortlisting Agent - New Job Applicant
